# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

At Nexura Security, the security of our users and their sites is paramount. We actively provide security updates for the latest major release of Nexura AI Search Optimizer.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability within Nexura AI Search Optimizer, please do **NOT** disclose it publicly or open a public GitHub issue.

Please report all security vulnerabilities to our dedicated security team at **security@nexurasecurity.com** or use the GitHub Security Advisory "Report a vulnerability" feature in this repository.

We treat all security reports with high urgency and will respond within 24 hours to verify the report and coordinate a patch. Responsible disclosures will be publicly credited in our changelog once the fix is released.

Thank you for keeping the WordPress ecosystem secure!
